_comment: Pins common ingredient names (normalizeName form) to a specific USDA FoodData Central fdcId so search fuzziness doesn't pick an odd match (e.g. a branded item or a cooked-vs-raw variant). The usda-nutrition edge function consults this before falling back to /foods/search. Keep raw (uncooked) variants for pantry staples; pick whole-food (Foundation / SR Legacy) entries.
